entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Is this about the scam group?[n]I heard some of the students[n]have become victims...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It would cause quite a lot of buzz if you[n]could solve it. Let me know if you learn[n]anything!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I will help any way I can. I'll start by[n]looking for rumors about Iida.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: If you find anything, be sure[n]to let me know too!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Did my information come in handy?
It did, thanks.
I never asked for your help.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: No problem. I just want to see[n]you guys succeed.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Oh, don't be like that. I just want[n]to see you guys succeed.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: You wanted to ask Iida something,[n]right? He's still in the classroom with[n]Takamaki-san.

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: [lName]-kun... Is President Niijima[n]keeping an eye on you?

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: Is there something else?

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: The student council is on edge.[n]Hurry up... Do you have anything[n]you want to ask about?
The mafia.
The victims at our school.
Iida.
Nishiyama.

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: I heard the muggings, scams, prostitution,[n]and drugs are making them tons of money.

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: Most of their victims have been high[n]schoolers, leading our school to warn[n]its students as well.

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: But... nobody actually knows how[n]they operate. Even the police are[n]completely lost.

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: The principal asked for us to come[n]forward with any information we[n]might have, right?

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: I heard someone did come to the[n]student council, saying they were[n]being threatened...

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: I don't want to assume this of you...[n]but you didn't have anything to do[n]with that, right?

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: Iida-kun, from your class? I've heard[n]he's a serious student...

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: Although he has seemed a little down[n]lately. I wonder what happened...

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: Nishiyama-kun? Are you looking for him?

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: He's a really serious student with great[n]grades. I always see him at the library[n]after school.

entries.speaker: Newspaper Club Member
entries.en: The library's just up on the floor above[n]this one... Why don't you go talk to him?
